content.text: The audit found a real contract gap, not just naming polish: resource redaction lists existed but were dead metadata. The kernel now has binding input/output redaction fields and destructive target contracts; I’m wiring those through every function manifest and making destructive schemas require the declared target ID.

All 29 capability factories are now wired with explicit redaction and resource targets; every destructive operation gets an ID-required schema. I’m running a single formatter pass now—one lightweight process—to both make the generated source maintainable and catch parser errors before tests.
